title: Correct Moon mass
description: Essential: Final answer for part (1) is derived and matches M = 32π²R³/(GT²).

title: Correct Moon density
description: Essential: Final answer for part (2) is derived and matches ρ = 24π/(GT²).

title: Orbital radius identification
description: Important: Recognizes that orbital radius is 2R (altitude R plus lunar radius R).

title: Gravity-centripetal equation
description: Important: Sets gravitational force equal to centripetal force: GMm/(2R)² = m(2π/T)²(2R).

title: Density formula application
description: Important: Correctly uses ρ = M/V with spherical volume V = (4/3)πR³.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional: Shows clear algebraic steps to solve for M and simplify ρ expression.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units throughout or notes final units (kg, kg/m³).

title: Orbital radius error
description: Pitfall: Uses R instead of 2R for orbital radius in gravitational or centripetal equation.

title: Centripetal acceleration mistake
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect centripetal formula (e.g., v²/R instead of ω²r or wrong ω expression).

title: Volume or algebra error
description: Pitfall: Makes error in spherical volume formula or in simplifying M/V expression.
